prompts.name: Woodland
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas for Unity, genuinely transparent background. Reference image is only a style and craftsmanship reference, do not copy its UI or buildings. Create four distinct lush European garden/woodland trees arranged in a precise 2-column by 2-row equal-cell grid, each tree completely isolated with generous transparent padding, no labels or border. Top left: majestic rounded oak with layered leafy crown; top right: airy silver birch with several bright green canopy lobes and visible ivory trunk; bottom left: rich broad-canopy red maple with green-gold foliage; bottom right: softly drooping willow. Full tree from crown to rooted base, no cut branches, softly painted isometric game assets, 35-degree elevated orthographic view, consistent gentle warm daylight from upper left, richly shaded leaf masses, beautiful volume, readable at a distance, small grass/root tuft at base, no cast ground shadow beyond base. Polished warm hand-painted environment quality like reference, compatible with detailed warm cream/copper reclaimed town buildings. Four trees of comparable height occupying their own cells; 2048x2048 square atlas, transparent alpha, no checkerboard baked in, no sky, no terrain rectangle, no buildings, no text.

prompts.name: Gardens
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production environment sprite atlas for a lush isometric Unity town game. Reference image only guides lush natural garden craftsmanship; do not duplicate exact objects or UI. A precise 4-column by 3-row grid of 12 separate full isolated props on genuine transparent background, each contained within its cell with generous transparent margins, no labels/dividers. Row1 left-to-right: broad flowering hydrangea shrub with pale cream flowers; dense rounded mixed-green shrub with small red blossoms; uneven cluster of rounded pale moss-covered river rocks; bank clump of tall cattail reeds and iris. Row2: natural low white-and-yellow wildflower bed with grass; purple lavender and pink flowers in a low organic clump; low curved stone garden wall with creeping green ivy; neatly clipped yet organic hedge section with flowering vine. Row3: two welcoming weathered blue-green wooden garden benches as one small seating vignette with flower pot; timber garden pergola covered in flowering vine; weathered timber and stone footbridge seen diagonally isometric with open walkway; curved pale stone fountain with turquoise basin, water spout and dense greenery at the back. No people, no buildings, no ground rectangles, no sign text. Consistent 35 degree elevated orthographic view, warm soft daylight upper-left, lush volumetric painted forms, visually generous foliage, polished premium garden game sprite quality, 2048x1536 landscape atlas, retain true transparent alpha.

prompts.name: Ground
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production hand-painted seamless terrain material atlas for a beautiful lush isometric garden town game; reference is only mood/style guidance. Square 2048x2048 image with four precisely equal square texture quadrants touching without borders or gutters. Each quadrant is a flat top-down seamless tileable albedo material, no perspective, no objects, no shadows of trees, no buildings, no text. Upper left: beautiful softly painted fresh meadow grass, medium-light natural spring green, subtle fine blades and occasional tiny clover, low contrast at macro scale, not photographic noisy yellow-brown. Upper right: warm pale ochre packed earth garden footpath with fine sandy texture and tiny scattered pebbles, soft color variation, no stones larger than a small pebble. Lower left: irregular rounded pale warm-grey flagstones set closely together, moss in some shallow gaps, handcrafted garden paving, stones with softly painted bevel light not heavy black outlines. Lower right: tranquil turquoise teal shallow water, softly painted gentle ripples, transparent-feeling subtle reflected light, broad calm low contrast, no fish, no shore. The four square quadrants must each fill exactly a quarter of the canvas with no separation, perfect edges, full opaque colors; production texture atlas, appealing soft richly painted material rendering consistent with premium garden game reference.
